changelog: **Employer recruiting analytics (#1911):** `GET /api/company/analytics` takes `?from=&to=&requisitionId=` (a malformed or inverted range falls back to the default window, never a 500; another company's role is a 404; the fail-closed guard for a COMPANY without `companyId` is unchanged) and returns a `recruiting` report over the company's `Application`s: funnel conversion and time-to-hire through `funnelKpi`'s `stageConversions()` / `timeToHire()` (censoring-aware), time-to-fill from the requisition's opening to the seat taken by an accepted offer (`Offer.requisitionCountedAt`, #1854 — an unfilled role is excluded and the considered population is returned), source breakdown by `Application.source` with hire rate, and a monthly trend of applications / advances / hires. New `GET /api/company/analytics/benchmark`: 403 `feature_locked` without the company's `ADVANCED_ANALYTICS`; with it, the company's hire rate against the other employers of its programme through `benchmarkPool`'s `benchmarkFigures()` and both floors (`MIN_RELATIONS`, `MIN_OTHER_PROGRAMS`) — no employer name, id, count or pool size leaves. `/company/analytics` gains the report with date/role filters, print, and an Excel export of the same payload when the plan carries `REPORT_EXPORT`. Maths in `src/lib/recruitingAnalytics.ts`.

en: Companies get a recruiting report: funnel, time to hire, time to fill, where candidates came from and a monthly trend for any period — with print, Excel export and, on Employer Plus, an anonymous benchmark.
tr: Şirketler bir işe alım raporu alıyor: herhangi bir dönem için huni, işe alım süresi, doldurma süresi, adayların nereden geldiği ve aylık eğilim — yazdırma, Excel dışa aktarma ve Employer Plus'ta anonim kıyaslama ile.
de: Unternehmen erhalten einen Recruiting-Bericht: Trichter, Zeit bis zur Einstellung, Besetzungsdauer, Herkunft der Bewerbungen und monatlicher Verlauf für jeden Zeitraum – mit Drucken, Excel-Export und, in Employer Plus, einem anonymen Vergleich.
